article: The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team is releasing more details about an RCMP shooting in Edson that injured a 27-year-old man on Friday afternoon.

According to information released by the independent investigator on Saturday, the man who was shot had gone to the probation office at Edson's courthouse, located in the town's provincial building, to speak with a probation officer. ASIRT said the man was "visibly upset, displayed signs of impairment and engaged in erratic behaviour."
ASIRT said the man produced a weapon and threatened to kill himself. Staff asked the man to leave and called RCMP.

"Edson RCMP members responded to the courthouse and located the man in a grassy area to the north west of the courthouse, directly across the road from a busy commercial area," according to the statement. "A confrontation occurred that resulted in the man being shot and wounded by police, suffering life-threatening injuries."
The man was known to police.
He was airlifted to Edmonton by STARS Air Ambulance and is now considered to be in stable condition.
Edson is about 200 kilometres west of Edmonton on Highway 16.
ASIRT said on Saturday that investigators are looking to speak with anyone who witnessed the incident, particularly members of a crew that had been working at a hotel across the street.
Anyone with information is being asked to call ASIRT at 780-644-1483.
